resource.ask: VISA resource of the lock-in (GPIB address 8 is the factory default) or its RS-232 serial port
resource.help: Examples: GPIB0::8::INSTR (GPIB), /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3 (RS-232 at 9600 baud through a USB-serial adapter), TCPIP0::192.168.1.40::inst0::INSTR or tcp://192.168.1.40:5025 (SR860/SR865A over LAN, or an SR830 behind a LAN-GPIB gateway). `pyvisa` lists what it can see; with none installed, type the string.
